pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What can you write when you cannot type "ü"? (1 mark)
   A. uu
   B. ui
   C. ue
   D. u

2. How is the letter V named in German? (1 mark)
   A. fow
   B. hah
   C. ah
   D. ess

3. What does "Bis morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. good day (daytime greeting)
   C. thank you
   D. see you tomorrow

4. What does "jung" mean? (1 mark)
   A. old
   B. tall
   C. young
   D. small

5. Which little word goes with the noun "Kind"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

6. What does "der Tisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cooker
   B. table
   C. door
   D. sofa

7. What does "der Schrank" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bedroom
   B. cupboard or wardrobe
   C. door
   D. sofa

8. What are "Anführungszeichen"? (1 mark)
   A. Full stops
   B. Hyphens
   C. Quotation marks
   D. Question marks

9. Which little word goes with the noun "Donnerstag"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. den
   D. der

10. What does "Mai" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. October
   C. December
   D. May

11. Which German word is the number 11? (1 mark)
   A. zwanzig
   B. sieben
   C. elf
   D. sechzehn

12. What does "die Party" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. song
   B. party
   C. cake
   D. birthday

13. What does "der Kohl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. onion
   C. cabbage or kale
   D. bean

14. What does "die Banane" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. cabbage or kale
   C. meat
   D. banana

15. What does "die Schulter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tooth
   B. toe
   C. shoulder
   D. face

16. What does "schwarze Haare" mean? (1 mark)
   A. big hands
   B. black hair
   C. small feet
   D. brown eyes

17. What does "kühl" mean? (1 mark)
   A. cool
   B. warm
   C. wet
   D. hot

18. Which little word goes with the noun "Wind"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. den
   D. die

19. What does "Was macht sie?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is she doing?
   B. Who is she?
   C. Where is she?
   D. How old is she?

20. What does "schlafen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to sleep
   B. to speak
   C. to eat
   D. to see

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the plural of Auge, Hand and Zahn in German. (3 marks)

22. Read: "Kamau hat Geburtstag. Er ist zehn Jahre alt." Say in English who has a birthday and how old he is. (2 marks)

23. Give three tips for reading a tongue twister well. (3 marks)

24. Write two sentences in German to say where family members are at home. (3 marks)

25. Write the German sound for each letter group: ei and ie. Give an example word for each. (2 marks)

26. Say what "Zum Frühstück trinke ich Tee" means in English. (2 marks)

27. Read: "Im Wohnzimmer ist ein Sofa. In der Küche ist ein Kühlschrank." Say where each item is in English. (3 marks)

28. Write a sentence in German that tells in which month your birthday is. (2 marks)

29. Write these numbers in German: 14, 16, 18. (3 marks)

30. Write three healthy foods and two unhealthy foods in German. (3 marks)

31. Explain what reading in chunks means and why it helps. (2 marks)

32. Explain how the adjective "windig" is made from the noun "Wind". Give one more example. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #5 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — ue
   ü can be written as ue, ö as oe and ä as ae.

2. A — fow
   In German the letter V is called fow.

3. D — see you tomorrow
   Bis morgen means see you tomorrow.

4. C — young
   jung is the opposite of alt.

5. B — das
   It is das Kind, so the little word is das.

6. B — table
   der Tisch means table.

7. B — cupboard or wardrobe
   der Schrank means cupboard or wardrobe.

8. C — Quotation marks
   They show the words someone says.

9. D — der
   It is der Donnerstag, so the little word is der.

10. D — May
   Mai means May.

11. C — elf
   11 in German is elf.

12. B — party
   die Party means party.

13. C — cabbage or kale
   der Kohl means cabbage or kale.

14. D — banana
   die Banane means banana.

15. C — shoulder
   die Schulter means shoulder.

16. B — black hair
   schwarz = black, Haare = hair.

17. A — cool
   kühl is cool.

18. B — der
   It is der Wind, so the little word is der.

19. A — What is she doing?
   was macht sie means what does she do.

20. A — to sleep
   schlafen means to sleep.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Augen, die Hände, die Zähne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kamau has a birthday and he is ten years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read slowly at first; add a few words at a time; speed up only when it is clear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mama ist in der Küche. Papa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct in der / im.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: ei sounds like eye (nein). ie sounds like ee (Tier).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound with an example.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: For breakfast I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for breakfast, 1 mark for drink tea.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: The sofa is in the living room. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct place and 1 mark for the items.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe im Mai Geburtstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for a correctly spelled month.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: vierzehn, sechzehn, achtzehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Healthy: Obst, Gemüse, Bohnen. Unhealthy: Süßigkeiten, Limonade.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for three healthy foods, 1 mark for two unhealthy foods, 1 mark for correct spelling.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means reading groups of words together, so your reading sounds smooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the reason.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Add -ig to the noun: Wind + -ig = windig. Another example: Sonne + -ig = sonnig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule, 1 mark for the example.
